propositions: The LLM judge's Pass-2/Pass-3 decision must be stable across repeated judgments on the same finding; measured via 3 self-consistent votes per finding over N≥50 findings from the R5 cohort (G6/E4/T3 criteria), passing iff Fleiss' κ≥0.6 AND raw agreement≥0.8, which gates R5 landing.

The gate verdict must be stable under section-order permutation of input plans; measured via 3 distinct section orderings per plan over N≥14 permutable plans (≥3 top-level sections from corpus_sample.json), passing iff Fleiss' κ≥0.6 AND raw agreement≥0.8, which gates R3 landing.

Infra-INDETERMINATE verdicts carrying coverage.llm_unavailable or coverage.verify_failed flags are excluded and re-run, as they represent execution failures not stable judge outcomes; only genuine judge-INDETERMINATE (neither flag) counts as a stable category.

E6 measures judge stochastic stability, not accuracy; it never treats any judge output as ground truth and re-judges frozen, committed samples (e6_selfconsistency_inputs.jsonl, e6_ordershuffle_inputs.jsonl) to isolate variance from plan/ticket-store changes.

The agentic Pass-2 verifier requires both an explicit repo_root parameter AND an active gate_source.gate_read_root session with gate_source.resolve_gate_handle to activate code-grounding tools; E6 harness verifies this wiring for the G6/E4/T3 CODEBASE_GROUNDED criteria.

Experiment B uses a deterministic per-plan seeding rule (SEED = int(plan_id.split('-')[0], 16)) to generate exactly 3 distinct permutations (identity + 2 shuffled orderings), and operates against a throwaway REBAR_TRACKER_DIR store clone so plan edits do not mutate the real tickets store.
